action_items: No functional issues found in iteration 3 modules.

(Note) When running test_modules_iter3.py, pass -n 0 to disable xdist parallelism – the SMS tenant-enabled toggle is shared state and parallel workers can race (same guidance applies to iteration 2 suite).
(Nitpick) Courier login screen 'C' clear button has no data-testid; added via get_by_role in test (works but a data-testid='courier-key-clear' would be cleaner).
critical_code_review_comments: modules.py send_customer_sms: cost is charged even when the SMS gateway returns an error – OK for mock, but a real integration should persist a 'failed' status with cost=0.
modules.py admin_put_config rebuild of modules order relies on DEFAULT_MODULES ordering – fine, but any future module added only to DB won't survive the PUT round-trip (filtered out). Document this.

modules.py rcp_clock linearly scans employees + verify_password per record. Fine for demo (handful of PINs) but O(N) bcrypt per clock-in – consider indexing by PIN hash prefix or a per-tenant Bloom filter if employee count grows.

get_actor sets actor['role']/tenant_id from JWT payload; token payload MUST include tid/role on pin-login – already does, but if a future endpoint mints a minimal token it will silently drop role → 403s. Add a schema check in decode_token.

AppShell gating uses mods[n.mod] !== false (default-on). This is correct, but if platform-level module.enabled=false, the frontend still shows the item unless tenant override is explicit false. Backend effective_modules already AND-s them; frontend should respect it too for consistency.
